items.name: Apache Iceberg tables
items.explanation: Iceberg is a layer over data files that tracks which files make up a table, so Spark, Flink, Hive and other engines can read and write the same table safely at once.

items.name: YARN as a cluster resource manager
items.explanation: YARN is Hadoop's resource manager. A central ResourceManager arbitrates resources among applications, and a NodeManager on each machine runs and monitors their containers.

assumedBy.quote: runs on 75 cores and 1.2 terabytes of memory on the YARN cluster
